allowed_targets.description: Server-side hostname allowlist. Must never be empty - an empty list would mean 'nothing is allowed', which is the fail-closed default, but an empty list passed here is almost certainly a misconfiguration (no target can ever be tested), so it's rejected instead of silently accepted.
allowed_targets.title: Allowed Targets

enforce_local_only.description: Must be true for any deployment of this project. False is accepted by the schema (so a future legitimate non-local use case isn't structurally impossible) but every local default and every example in this repo keeps it true - see field_validator below for the specific strings this blocks regardless.
enforce_local_only.title: Enforce Local Only

environment.description: Deployment environment name, e.g. 'local', 'ci'. Never 'production' for this project.
environment.title: Environment

evidence_dir.description: Local filesystem path for evidence artifacts.
evidence_dir.title: Evidence Dir
